settings.title: Why the price is not shown on the website?
settings.content: Since each statue is custom-made, there isn’t a fixed price. The cost ranges 60-99/person, depending on the complexity. We'll need to review your picture first, and then give an exact quote.

settings.title: Do I need to pay before seeing the 3D design?
settings.content: Yes, a minimum deposit is required, as the 3D modeling is the hardest and most time-invested stage of the process, this typically takes 3D artists 3-5 business days to complete. Therefore, this deposit ensures that we can fully commit to bringing your project to completion.

settings.title: What if I don't like my 3D design?
settings.content: No worries at all. We're happy to adjust it based on your feedbacks until it meets your expectations.

settings.title: My photo doesn't show legs, can you do it?
settings.content: You can either send separate pictures that show your legs, shoes, or we’ll design it for you by ourselves!

settings.title: How long it takes to receive my order?
settings.content: About 10 - 23 business days.

settings.title: Can I change to a new picture after my 3D is made?
settings.content: No problems! However, as the 3D-modeling is made manually, switching to a new pic means starting over—which takes additional time.

settings.title: Can you make me slimmer in the statue?
settings.content: Sure! We can modify everything. Even if you like to be more muscular that's easy!

settings.title: We don't have a picure together, can you  still make a statue from different photos?
settings.content: Absolutely! We'll show you full 3D preview for your approval before finalizing it.
